payload.question: Plumb has a written rule that you can ask for a study by typing /plumb study <topic> or by asking in plain words. We changed the plain-words case: the agent now recognises the request itself and proposes the study straight away. Should the old rule be updated to the new behaviour, or kept as it is with the new behaviour written as a separate rule?
payload.text: Update the old rule to the new behaviour
